name: The Chisel + Pester + 98 AxE
description: The English Oi! punk band The Chisel returns to Porto, performing with Pester and 98 AxE. The concert takes place at Woodstock 69 Rock Bar.
longDescription:
The Chisel, an English Oi! punk band, is set to perform in Porto. They will be joined by Pester and 98 AxE for this event.

The concert is scheduled for November 6, 2026, starting at 9:00 PM. It will be held at the Woodstock 69 Rock Bar, located at R. São Roque da Lameira, 1212.

Tickets are priced at 15€, with a pre-sale option available for 12€.
